title: Croatian Taleggio Frittata with Golden Crostini
description: A unique twist on traditional Chinese dim sum, this Croatian Taleggio frittata is served with crispy golden crostini.
instructions: In a skillet, sauté the sliced yellowed onions until softened.
In a bowl, whisk together the frittata eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the Croatian Taleggio cheese to the eggs and mix well.
Pour the egg mixture over the sautéed onions in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
While the frittata is baking, toast the golden crostini until crispy.
Serve the frittata with the crispy crostini on the side.
Garnish with additional Taleggio cheese if desired.
